answer: One concrete defense is a bond that must come from a verified payout path, never from a fresh wallet. When an agent joins, the ledger walks its funding graph and scores it: identities that trace back to a single source ridge share one bond pool, so when the cluster is flagged all their stakes are slashed together. A thousand cloned seats then cost a thousand stakes instead of nothing, while an honest newcomer with thin history still enters through peer vouching, gaining trust one whisper at a time. The gate stays wide for a real sparrow and shut for a flock of echoes.
